findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/evidence-readiness.js::mistyped pin landing on another ticket-naming commit in resolvewritercommits
findings.title: mistyped pin landing on another ticket-naming commit in resolveWriterCommits
findings.action: Store each pin's PR number as data and require the pinned subject to carry (#<pr>) as well as (<ticket>).
findings.disposition_rationale: The spec (section 1 design principles, section 4 failure modes) deliberately leaves a wrong-but-verifying pin to review of the pin table and fixes the value shape to null or a 40-hex sha, which a {sha, pr} shape would break. Each of the six pins was checked at build time against origin/main's first-parent log and its PR number (#1057, #1053, #1055, #1054, #1062, #1061). A real-checkout test was not added because CI checkouts may be shallow, where every pin falls back by design.

occurrences.title: mistyped pin landing on another ticket-naming commit in resolveWriterCommits

findings.finding_id: test/faff-1263-evidence-readiness.test.mjs::earlier-commit temp-repo test passes without the pin in faff-1263-evidence-readiness test
findings.title: earlier-commit temp-repo test passes without the pin in faff-1263-evidence-readiness test
findings.action: Add a later follow-up commit naming the ticket so only the pin resolves to the merge.
findings.disposition_rationale: Added a follow-up commit after the merge; the newest-match fallback now resolves to the follow-up and oldest-match to the ADR commit, so only the pin yields the asserted merge commit with before_since false. 38/38 pass.

findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/evidence-readiness.js::resolvewriters exported beyond the spec's export list
findings.title: resolveWriters exported beyond the spec's export list
findings.disposition_rationale: The spec's DONE list requires an in-process temp-repo test of resolveWriters with an injected merges argument, which needs the export. Any in-process caller is itself a reviewed code change; no argv flag or environment variable reaches the parameter.

occurrences.title: resolveWriters exported beyond the spec's export list

findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/evidence-readiness.js::no report signal when a shipped pin degrades to fallback
findings.title: no report signal when a shipped pin degrades to fallback
findings.action: Add a pin_verified field per writer.
findings.disposition_rationale: The spec fixes the writers[] record shape as unchanged with no new field (section 3 report shape and a DONE item). A degraded pin shows as a commit differing from WRITER_MERGES in the --json output.

occurrences.title: no report signal when a shipped pin degrades to fallback

findings.title: FAFF-1268 ships unpinned
findings.disposition_rationale: FAFF-1268 has not merged on origin/main 551bf2eb; the spec's out-of-scope list defers it, and a follow-up step on FAFF-1270 pins it after it merges. Until then it keeps today's fail-closed behaviour.
